personal.about: I am a MERN Stack & React Native Developer specializing in building scalable, high-performance web and cross-platform mobile applications using React.js, React Native, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and TypeScript. I have hands-on experience developing production-ready applications, integrating REST APIs, implementing secure authentication, and optimizing application performance. I enjoy solving real-world problems, writing clean and maintainable code, and continuously learning modern technologies to build reliable software solutions.
